title: UAE grants visa-on-arrival to eligible Filipinos from June 25; entry fees start at Dh100
summary: Filipino travellers now enjoy a simplified entry into the UAE with a new visa-on-arrival facility, effective June 25. Eligible passport holders with valid visas or residence permits from select countries can now obtain their UAE visa upon landing.
